notes: v2 restructure based on batch_001 results: both 002 and 003 drifted from 'bottle' to 'globe/display piece' and lost the interior orrery, label, and cork/seal entirely. Root cause: prompts were several hundred tokens of prose; SDXL's CLIP encoding heavily dilutes content past ~75 tokens, so the tail (where the specific details lived) barely influenced the image. v2 rule: the subject, its defining shape, and the 2-3 must-have details go in the FIRST sentence. Style/lighting/mood compressed into short comma phrases. Total target under ~120 tokens. Entry ids continue from v1 (007+) so both batches coexist in one catalog for direct comparison.
